Each required job that fails posts the red-run notice as it fails, so the batch runner starts the drop and fix at once. 2. The other jobs run on and name any second bad lane. 3. The new head's run supersedes the old one. 4. R4's lint-first cancel stays. Steps: lane-lint-once-fail-fast (R4), and one new step for the wake.
